name: Refresh agent knowledge library
description: Refresh official OpenAI, Anthropic, and GitHub Copilot source metadata and prepare reviewed knowledge updates.
prompt: Read knowledge/MAINTENANCE.md and follow its Copilot Automation runbook. Run the bounded source refresh, inspect and review changed official pages, update only affected provider and topic syntheses with primary citations and actual retrieval dates, preserve last-good material and pending/failed distinctions, run focused validation, and prepare a reviewable branch/pull request. Never treat index discovery as reading a page, copy source prose wholesale, or merge the result. Keep workflow logic in the repository files.
activation_notes: Weekly is the intended cadence. The exact day/time and coordinator approval are pending; this template is not an active Automation. Confirm repository Automation settings/tool availability before creation. The null model leaves selection to the platform default. Cloud Automation runs against the repository default branch, so merge this definition and its runbook/scripts there before creating or enabling it.
